name: Canards Illimités Canada Wetland Restoration Support and Funding Program (Quebec)
summary: Coaching (up to 200 hours) and up to $25,000 to help Quebec municipalities, Indigenous communities and non-profits develop wetland restoration or creation projects and prepare funding applications. Supported by the Quebec environment ministry.
